about: Establishing clauses taken from each Overseas Territory's constitution or founding Order in Council on legislation.gov.uk, read on 22 November 2026. Older orders exist only as scanned PDFs and were read by OCR (tesseract), so their snippets may carry OCR errors. Licence of the source text: Open Government Licence v3.0.
